data.name: Vishnu
data.gender_notes: Vishnu is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root viṣ, 'to pervade, to enter' — 'the all-pervading one'. Its root is Sanskrit viṣ (विष्). Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu trimurti. Vishnu is a Sanskrit name meaning “All-pervading; the preserver”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vishnu expresses “All-pervading; the preserver”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root viṣ, 'to pervade, to enter' — 'the all-pervading one'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishnu total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Vishnu is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “All-pervading; the preserver”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Vishnu is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “All-pervading; the preserver” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Vishnu; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Vishnu is a central deity in Hinduism and is mentioned in various Vedic texts.

historical_references.reference: Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu trimurti.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Vishnu.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Vishnu?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Vishnu is 3 (ruling planet Jupiter). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Does Vishnu have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Vishnu is recorded as a hindu name meaning “All-pervading; the preserver”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Vishnu?
